name: World of Clashes
storyline: Long ago the Jinn Lord Al-Marid was sealed beneath the black massif at the centre of the Najd. The sealing split the desert in two: the Light, who keep the sun-facing city in the east, and the Dark, who hold the moon city in the west. Generations later the seal is thinning, the cave beneath it reshapes itself with every descent, and both banners send heroes into the sand — some to hold the seal, some to see what waits under it.
summary:
World of Clashes is a pixel-art desert MMORPG set in a fictional Najd. Two factions — the Light of Sun City and the Dark of Moon City — divide a living open world of dunes, oases, bazaars and snowbound poles.

Players farm mobs for gear across six rarity tiers, take on quests, buy and ride camel mounts, and descend into Kahf Al-Arwah, an endless cave that carves a new maze on every run and supports four-player parties. Open-world faction PvP runs across two realms.

The centrepiece is the ranked arena: two 1v1 ladders, Open and Mirror, where gear is normalized so duels are decided by skill rather than progression. Each duel begins with a ten-second preparation phase in which both fighters choose their build before the fight starts. Warrior and mage each have six ability slots that unlock while levelling, and every slot offers two alternative builds.

The game is free to play with cosmetic-only purchases, and is fully playable in English and Arabic.
